featured_reviews.review_text:
Somewhat hidden away across from the bustling Regal Circle, Avante is easily missed.  We started going there because of their lovely camel bone boxes, which have become a staple present for friends.

The tiled floor is an artwork in its own right.  There's a nice variety of handicrafts without being too overwhelming.

Great staff, not pushy - let you browse at leisure.  Prices are reasonable, especially compared with other shops in the vicinity.

featured_reviews.name: Vinesh Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avante Cottage Crafts was an A++++ experience.  Every time I look at the pieces I purchased, I not only remember my trip to Mumbai, but also the great shopping experience the staff provided.

The Pieces: The large selection of high quality pieces made it a one-stop shop for me.  I walked away with pieces that range from classical to modern, enhance any room, and make for great conversation.  I was most impressed with the wood-pressed painting and silk tapestries I purchased for my home.

The Staff: The staff is absolutely dedicated to service and ensuring you'll have a great experience.  They personally select the items they stock, and it shows in the way they help you.  Once the team knew more about my home and the aesthetic I was looking for, they were able to quickly pick out items I would like - explaining the origin, workmanship, and significance of each piece.  They even suggested ways to best display the pieces as an ensemble.

Shipping: Packaging and shipping were also very easy.  I decided not to ship the items so they were hand-delivered to my hotel room - free of charge (although I did tip).  Each piece was wrapped in bubble tape and styrofoam, and individually boxed.  I arrived home with showroom quality pieces and immediately put them on display.

Bottom line: I'll happily return on my next visit, and think you'll have as great an experience as I did.  The store is easy to find near the Regal Cinema; the selection of pieces are amazing; and the helpful staff is even better.

Phillips Antiques is a highly reputed antique store with a rich legacy, well known among celebrities. featured_reviews.name: anjitha mekkayil anand
featured_reviews.review_text:
Phillips Antiques, nestled in the heart of Mumbai's heritage district near Colaba, is more than just a shop; it's a living museum steeped in history. Established in 1860, this family-owned establishment is one of the oldest antique stores in the city, and stepping inside feels like a journey back in time.
The carefully curated collection is a treasure trove of colonial-era finds and exquisite pieces from across Asia. From magnificent carved wooden furniture – beds, armchairs, settees, and marble-topped tables – to delicate Victorian curios, gilded mirrors, and religious statues, every item tells a story. You'll find a fascinating array of lamps, lithographs, old maps, and photographs of pre-Independence Bombay, offering a nostalgic glimpse into the city's past.
The true charm of Phillips Antiques lies not just in its impressive inventory, but also in the passion and knowledge of its proprietors. They are more like curators, happy to share the provenance and significance of each piece, making the Browse experience educational and truly captivating. While the prices reflect the rarity and quality of the items, even if you're not in the market to buy, a visit to Phillips Antiques is a must for anyone with an appreciation for history, art, and the unique allure of old-world charm in modern Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Sky & Patty Williamson
featured_reviews.review_text: I had the good fortune of finding Natesan’s beautiful collection a few years ago and was delighted to return on my recent visit to Mumbai in March 2026.  The showroom is two levels, a beautifully curated display of original antiquities for viewing on the first floor and an equally beautiful and intriguing display of finest quality reproductions and non antique vintage pieces available for purchase on the second floor.  The collection was quite diverse with brass and bronze hindu statues, wood carved pieces, and artwork - stunning.  A wide range of sizes and pricepoints are also available and at good value given the very high quality of the pieces.  I had a wonderful discussion of the various pieces with Pushpa who was very charming and extremely knowledgeable about the history and artistic styles.  This is a no pressure environment and i would have viewed the visit alone as a highpoint, though i was thrilled to take home a beautiful Kerala mural.  Pushpa was very helpful in talking through the transport options and it was a seamless and easy transaction.  Definitely make a visit to Natesan’s a priority on your next Mumbai visit.  Cheers! Patty

name: Mysore Creation
description:
Mysore Creation, founded in 1958 by Shri. A.R. Nikam, is a celebration of master craftsmanship in Indian Handicrafts. Being a craftsman himself, he aimed at promoting and uplifting under his able guidance artists from South India, thus giving raw talent a fulfilling direction.
Mysore Creation aims to represent the finesse and divine aspect of Indian Handicrafts.
Endless hours of designing and experimental use of raw materials resulted in a beautiful confluence of creativity to bring about the Grandeur of Indian Mythology.
While we strive to continue the legacy, we hope our journey attracts people who understand and appreciate the splendor of Indian Art.

featured_reviews.name: Nirupama Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
To me Mysore Creation is not just a store but an enriching experience each time I visit it.
A wide range of artifacts both period and contemporary , in various mediums such as in brass,copper,bronze ,wood ..greet you at the entrance .
The displays are interesting ...
Sneha , the talented artist who is a co- owner of the store has displayed her brilliant paintings too..
Well ! I can say most modestly that I own 7 paintings of hers and a tall wood carving of God Vishnu in a seated posture...I love the stone finish look which Sneha has given to it thus making it look like ...tge old world charm !!
The hanging antique brass diyas in the store have caught my attention and I do plan to buy them .
The statues of Lord Ganesha ,Lord Hanuman and Lord Shiva are crafted in one piece wood by special artisans who hail from across the country offering an insight into the enchanting mythology of our country..the ethic fabric of Indian art is strongly felt whilst one is walking through the gallery .
Each time I visit here I am filled with joy.
Thankyou Sneha for your service at all times .
Your spectacular range of paintings interest me too..!!

name: Saffronart

owner_posts.post_text: Our Summer Online Auction returns with an exciting catalogue featuring paintings, sculptures, and folk and tribal works by leading modern and contemporary artists such as M F Husain, Manjit Bawa, F N Souza, Jagdish Swaminathan, Subodh Gupta and more. Explore iconic names, rare works, and compelling narratives that define the evolving landscape of Indian art.⁠

The Design Sale presents an exquisite hand-picked selection, including Art Deco furniture, Mid-Century pieces, and vintage Italian design. Spanning lighting, indoor and outdoor furniture, tables and desks, and objets d’art, these works combine innovative design with streamlined symmetry, sleek linearity, and bold geometric forms that elevate everyday furniture into striking works of functional art.

Unveiling Saffronart’s Spring Auctions: The catalogues are now live and the viewings have begun. ⁠
⁠
We are pleased to present our Spring Auctions, featuring a thoughtful curation of Indian art, antiquities, and sculptures, held live and online across two days. Every piece in our auctions offers a glimpse into the legacy, creativity, and future of Indian art, celebrating some of the most prolific names of modern and contemporary art.⁠

Presenting: From Classical to Contemporary Auction. 

Saffronart returns with the first themed sale of the new year. The latest edition of From Classical to Contemporary offers a curated selection from India's long, celebrated artistic history. The diverse catalogue, now live, with paintings and sculptures that range from antiquity all the way to the present day, offer a glimpse into the rich heritage of the country.

featured_reviews.name: Farhana Madar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a truly wonderful experience with FCI Furniture, Mumbai. From the very beginning, the team made the process feel extremely personal and collaborative. I came in with a clear intent image and vision in mind for my bed and they took genuine interest in understanding exactly what I wanted.

I still remember the owner, Fazila, sharing that their goal is always to reflect the client’s wishes — and that philosophy truly shows in their work. From in-person discussions to detailed WhatsApp conversations, every step was handled with patience, care and clarity to ensure the final result felt just right.

They allowed me to go through multiple fabric manuals, never rushing the process, and helped me refine every detail. The buttoned tufted headboard has been crafted beautifully — plush, elegant and finished with great precision. The upholstery quality feels premium and the bed looks even better in person. Moreover, the quality of the wood used is excellent — the bed feels solid, sturdy and very well-built.

The entire piece was completed and delivered exactly on the promised date, with the experience being smooth, professional and surprisingly quick.

What stood out most was how warm, kind and hospitable the founders are. Even after delivery, their interest in seeing the bed styled and lived in made the experience feel very boutique and heartfelt — like being part of something created with care, not just a purchase.

Grateful to have had FCI Furniture be part of my home and everyday life. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for in-store and custom made furniture created with intention, craftsmanship and genuine warmth. 🤍

Very disappointing experience.

We placed an order for 18 pieces and paid in full, but only 15 pieces were delivered. To make matters worse, one of the items was incomplete and contained only one toy instead of the two that were supposed to be included.

The order was already delayed, and after receiving the incomplete shipment, we repeatedly tried contacting the seller through calls and messages. Unfortunately, there has been no response for several days. The lack of communication and after-sales support has been extremely frustrating.

We are still waiting for a resolution regarding the missing and incomplete items. Until this issue is addressed, we cannot recommend purchasing from this seller.

I hope the seller responds and resolves this matter promptly.

featured_reviews.name: Komal verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing — misleading website and no customer support
I have ordered from this store multiple times, and unfortunately, every single time there has been an issue.
One time, they sent my parcel with missing products.
And now again, their website showed the items as “in stock,” but after placing the order, I found out that they were actually not available. They still haven’t updated their website, which is completely misleading for customers.
Since then, I have been continuously chasing them for a refund and for order status updates. They do not pick up calls at all — I tried calling them multiple times a day — and they rarely respond to messages. Whenever they do reply, the information keeps changing every time, and there is no clear update.
This kind of experience is extremely stressful, especially for those of us running small businesses who rely on timely supplies.
Right now, I still do not have any proper update on my refund or my order.
Very unprofessional service.
I do not recommend ordering from this store unless they improve their communication, honesty, and website accuracy.

featured_reviews.name: Garima Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text: If possible to give 0 stars , will give to this store for the behaviour of the man managing the store sitting at the counter. He is horrible, rude , full of akkad and attitude and speaks foul with the customer (that too an female) . First of all they never have stock loaded in their store , then why have you opened a store! Second the person never picks up the call , and then throws attitude at the customer for not answering the calls. Two days back i had gone to their store for candle materials . Again they didnt have any stock so i asked him and he said it will come after two days. After 2 days i kept calling him to chk whether the stock has arrived but as usual - NO ANSWER . Then i had to travel one hour to the store just to hear a horribly rude man speaking to me and restock also. Everyone knows how difficult it is to travel in mUmbai.  he speaks rudely in full akkad as if i am some bhikari asking for money . He has the audacity to throw attitude on the customer who would have likely been this forever regular customer. Anyone who wants to still purchase from this person is free to do so , else can contact me - there are better vendors in mumbai who respond timely and politely and treat customers well. I only went here because it was closer to my place . But trust me there are many better vendors . Ive been dealing with candle making for 2 years .
